messages.author: 520e0fed4ef4fb37
messages.subject: function visibility in shiny pages
parts:
Hi,

I developed some shiny pages and put them into a package. The pages share some logic, so I would like to put the common code in some functions and avoid duplication. Unfortunately it seems that from the shiny pages I can only call the 'public' (i.e. exported) functions of my package and not the internal ones. Is it true, or am I missing anything?

Thanks for your help.

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: function visibility in shiny pages
parts:
You can call unexported functions with package:::function(). Note that there are three colons - if there were two colons, it could only call exported functions. It's generally frowned upon to call unexported functions from a package (because the unexported, internal functions in a package might change over time), but I guess if you are only doing it within your own package, that's not so bad.

Another possibility is, instead of putting your functions in a package the normal way (in the R/ directory), you can put them in the inst/ directory of your package, and then source them in each app, with something like this:
  source(system.file("sharedfunctions.r", package="mypackage"), local=TRUE)

-Winston
